---
title: "Improving Galaxy’s interface for agents running biological analyses"
abstract: |
  External agents can run analyses in Galaxy, but each tool search, parameter check and job-status request consumes model context.
  In 3,840 paired runs of 160 computational biology tasks with four models, accuracy through Galaxy was close to that of custom code (BixBench, 89.5% versus 88.3%).
  Failure records identified interface gaps, and compact replies with longer waits reduced BixBench token use from 122.4 to 54.3 million per 50-task run.
